sections.heading: About these terms
paragraphs: This GradeBook is run by {{controller}} for its schools. These terms set out the rules for using it. By signing in you agree to follow them. How your personal data is used is explained in the privacy notice, which you do not need to agree to: it applies whether or not you sign in.

sections.heading: What GradeBook is
paragraphs: GradeBook is a learning platform. Schools create courses with modules, pages, files, assignments, quizzes and discussions; staff set and mark work, keep gradebooks, take attendance and keep pastoral records; students hand in work, see their grades and check in to class; parents and guardians follow their child's progress; and members of a school can message each other. It is available on the web and in the GradeBook mobile app.
The GradeBook software is made by an independent developer; {{controller}} runs this installation, decides which features are switched on and is responsible for it.

sections.heading: Accounts and sign-in
paragraphs: You sign in with a one-time code sent to your email, or with Google, Microsoft or your school's own sign-in where the school has set it up. Staff can also protect their account with an authenticator app. When using GradeBook, you agree to:
list: Provide accurate information and keep it up to date
Keep access to your email account, sign-in codes and authenticator app secure and never share them
Use only the school, courses and roles you have been given
Tell your school, or {{contact}}, at once if you think someone else has used your account

sections.heading: Schools, roles and access
paragraphs: A school's administrators decide who belongs to the school, which roles and permissions staff have, and whether people may join automatically with their school email address. Inside a course, teachers manage the course, teaching assistants can mark and post announcements, and students see the published content and their own work and grades. Staff must use what they can see only for their work at the school.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
list: Enter false, misleading or fabricated student records, marks or attendance
Hand in work that is not yours, or help others cheat, where your school forbids it
Access, or try to access, schools, courses, conversations, records or files you have not been given
Copy personal data out of GradeBook for purposes other than your work at the school
Upload content that is unlawful, infringes someone else's rights, or contains malware
Use GradeBook to harass, bully, discriminate against or harm anyone
Reverse-engineer, scrape or overload GradeBook, or interfere with its security

sections.heading: Your content
paragraphs: You and your school keep ownership of the content you put into GradeBook, including coursework, files and messages. You must have the right to upload it. Staff are responsible for the accuracy of the records they enter and for checking marks before relying on them.

sections.heading: Availability
paragraphs: {{controller}} works to keep GradeBook available and keeps encrypted backups so data can be recovered after a failure, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted access. GradeBook may be unavailable for maintenance or for reasons outside its control.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: GradeBook is provided as it is, to the extent the law allows. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or your rights as a consumer or as a data subject.

sections.heading: Ending your use
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from your account settings. Records your school keeps about you (such as grades or attendance) stay under the school's control, as described in the privacy notice.
Access can be suspended for anyone who breaks these terms or puts GradeBook or its users at risk.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: These terms may change as GradeBook changes. The date at the top shows the latest version, and important changes are announced in GradeBook before they take effect.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, contact {{contact}}.
